title: A Clear View of the Pond
paras: 14 May, 7 a.m. Mist covered the pond when I arrived for work. Our [[charity|charity]] cares for this small nature reserve beside a village with a [[population|population]] of about 800. My job today was to clear the wooden bird-watching shelter before its first visitors arrived.

I put a [[cushion|cushion]] on the floor to protect my knees. Then I began to [[remove|remove]] old [[gum|gum]] stuck beneath a bench. Outside, a pair of ducks moved through the reeds. They came back [[frequently|frequently]] to one corner, carrying dry grass. I stopped cleaning to watch them more closely.

After ten minutes, I [[realize|realized]] that they were building a nest behind a fallen branch. Last spring, workers had cut all the reeds along this bank. [[nowadays|Nowadays]], we leave several wide strips standing. This simple change seemed [[effective|effective]]: the ducks had found a quiet place, hidden from the path but visible through our narrow window.

At nine, three village volunteers brought new signs for the shelter. When a duck appeared with a long feather, they began to [[cheer|cheer]]. I raised a finger to my lips, and they quickly fell silent. Before leaving, I added one line to our work book: clean the shelter, but leave the fallen branch. The pond had its own builders.
zh: 5月14日，早上7点。我来上班时，池塘上笼罩着薄雾。我们这家慈善机构负责照管这片小小的自然保护区，旁边的村庄约有800名居民。我今天的任务是在第一批游客到来之前，打扫木制观鸟屋。
我在地板上放了一个软垫，保护膝盖。然后，我开始清除粘在长凳下面的旧口香糖。屋外，一对鸭子在芦苇间穿行。它们叼着干草，频繁地回到同一个角落。我停下清扫，仔细观察起来。
十分钟后，我意识到它们正在一根倒下的树枝后面筑巢。去年春天，工作人员曾把这段岸边的芦苇全部割掉。如今，我们会留下几条宽宽的芦苇带。这个简单的改变似乎起了作用：鸭子找到了一处安静的地方，从小路上看不见，但透过我们狭窄的窗户却能看到。
九点，三位村里的志愿者给观鸟屋送来了新标牌。一只鸭子叼着长羽毛出现时，他们欢呼起来。我把一根手指放在唇边，他们很快安静下来。离开前，我在工作记录本上添了一行：打扫观鸟屋，但留下那根倒下的树枝。池塘也有自己的建筑工。

q.s: The writer was responsible for preparing the shelter before visitors came.
q.why: 作者的任务是在游客到来前打扫观鸟屋。

q.s: The volunteers had made the new signs themselves.
q.why: 只提到志愿者送来标牌，未说明谁制作。

q.s: The volunteers continued cheering after the writer raised a finger to their lips.
q.why: 作者示意安静后，志愿者很快停止出声。
